resources.string: Turn this on to let the Sklubot bots you allow look at this phone and use it for you: screenshots, taps, swipes, typing, opening apps. The phone asks you first, and Stop is always at hand.
Waiting for the code to be typed in Sklubot
Connection lost, trying again in %1$d s
This phone was removed from Sklubot. Turn the relay on again to link it anew.
The server no longer recognises this phone. Turn the relay on again to link it anew.
This version of the app is too old for your server: update it.
This phone connected again elsewhere; this connection was closed.
Choose your Sklubot server first (open the app once).
The relay needs a secure address (https). %1$s is not.
Link this phone: in Sklubot, open Settings → Computers and type this code.
The code works once, for 10 minutes. Never type it if someone else gave it to you.
You can link the phone again: turn the relay on to get a new code.
No bot can use this phone until you allow control again here.
Android lets an app see the screen and tap for you only through an accessibility service that you turn on yourself. Sklubot uses it only while a bot you allowed has control.
Open the accessibility settings, choose “Sklubot — phone control” (sometimes under “Installed apps” or “Downloaded apps”) and turn it on.
Android 13 and newer: if the switch is greyed out (“Restricted setting”), open the app info, tap ⋮ at the top right, then “Allow restricted settings”, and come back.
This phone runs a version of Android older than 11: bots can tap and type, but screenshots are not possible.
Notifications: not allowed (the Stop button lives in the notification)
What bots can and cannot do

They can: take screenshots, read the text on screen, tap, long-press, swipe and scroll, type in the field you are in, press Back, Home, Recent apps, open the notifications, open an app or a web address.

They cannot: run commands, act without your yes on this phone, use the apps you blocked, act on the lock screen, tap or type in Sklubot itself, change these settings. iPhone: impossible, iOS does not allow it.
None: every bot asks before taking control.
What bots did on this phone
Forget this server: removes the link, the bots allowed always and the lock from this phone. (Remove the phone in Sklubot too.)
Tap to answer. Without an answer in 60 seconds, it is refused.
It will see the screen and can tap, swipe, type and open apps, except in the apps you blocked.
Stop at any time: the red banner, the notification or the “Stop Sklubot” tile.
While one of these apps is on screen, bots can neither see nor touch the phone, and they cannot open it. Tick your banking, payment and other sensitive apps: Android cannot tell which ones they are.
Block the payment and banking apps I choose
Always protected as well: the lock screen, and tapping or typing in Sklubot itself.
Lets the bots you allow see and use this phone, only while the relay is on and after your yes.

Sklubot uses this service to take screenshots, read the text on screen, tap, swipe, type and press Back or Home on behalf of a bot you allowed, only while the relay is turned on in the app and after you accepted on this phone. Nothing is read or sent otherwise. Stop is always available (banner, notification, quick-settings tile).
